canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in Basel — 2026 calendar

parent.title: A Basel weekend, dinner-first: how the three angles dovetail

siblings.title: Things to do in Basel
siblings.summary: A weekend in Basel splits cleanly into a museum half-day, a Rhine swim with the Wickelfisch, and an Old Town walk — your hotel's BaselCard covers all of it.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Basel
siblings.summary: Three top-starred restaurants in Basel — Cheval Blanc (3★, La Liste #1), Roots (2★, plant-forward), Stucki (2★, closing Sept 2026 for renovation). How to choose.
